items.description: The second-largest city in Tajikistan, located on the Syr Darya River at the mouth of the Fergana Valley.
One of the oldest cities in Tajikistan, known as a cultural and historical center in the Khatlon Region.

items.description: An ancient city in northern Tajikistan, famous for its well-preserved medieval architecture and crafts.
An industrial city west of Dushanbe, primarily known for housing one of Central Asia's largest aluminum smelters.

A city in northern Tajikistan, nestled at the foot of the Turkestan Range.
